fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reports on a free-speech dispute involving radio commentator Barry Gray; continued investigative coverage alleging misconduct by Dr. T. Earl Moore and discussion of a related case involving Howard Hartman. Local civic and political coverage includes debate over Miami water-rate increases and calls for a referendum on the extra-long school term. Business and development news highlights oil exploration plans in the Florida Keys and commentary on tourism and economic conditions. Additional items address labor tactics and press freedom, public health initiatives (including syphilis case-finding), crime and law enforcement notes, and a feature on a new Miami-based television production company.
